versions.content: Name Pwm_ Edge Notification Type Kind Enumeration Range PWM_ RISING_ EDGE 0x00 Notification will be called when a rising edge occurs on the PWM output signal. PWM_ FALLING_ EDGE 0x01 Notification will be called when a falling edge occurs on the PWM output signal. PWM_ BOTH_ EDGES 0x02 Notification will be called when either a rising edge or falling edge occur on the PWM output signal. Description Definition of the type of edge notification of a PWM channel. Available via Pwm.h
